title: Leaving Los Angeles in 1928; the seasonal steamer
summary: Joe corrects Barry: he left Los Angeles in 1928 and did not return until about 1940-42, and the ship ran only May to October.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: This was around 1930 or '31, something like that?
Oh, no. Way after. See, I left Los Angeles in 1928.
Yes. And I didn't come back down here again until about 1940, '42, with the Orson Welles show, when Jimmie Noone died, and to record for Exner.
Well, roughly... I'll get into that stuff with Johnny Wittwer and all of them up there, and then Ory, naturally, on this next tape. But how long did you stay on this boat?
The season opened... It was a seasonal boat. They only ran from I think the first of May until the first of October, and then you was finished.
